[EN] I want you to be careful, . Enough people have seen you, and you've asked enough questions, that people are asking about you—and word is liable to get back to this mysterious treasure hunter.

You need to re-establish your cover story—that you're just another person helping out."That's probably a good idea."
[ES] Quiero que tengas cuidado, . Bastante gente te ha visto y has hecho suficientes preguntas como para que la gente empiece a preguntar por ti, y es probable que los rumores lleguen a este misterioso cazador de tesoros.

Necesitas restablecer tu coartada: que eres solo otra persona ayudando."That's probably a good idea."

[EN] Head out and make your way south to the Mysterious Ruins.

In the process, make a show of killing several of these big monsters.

When you get to the ruins, look for the Free Traders Collective group. They're gathering there, and I'd like to know why."I understand."
[ES] Sal y dirígete al sur hacia las Mysterious Ruins.

En el proceso, haz un espectáculo matando a varios de estos grandes monstruos.

Cuando llegues a las ruinas, busca al grupo Free Traders Collective. Se están reuniendo allí y me gustaría saber por qué."I understand."

[EN] I see you're getting around, killing big monsters. I was starting to think you were just here to loot the ruins of the federation camp.

So is this just a social call...?"Actually, I'm looking for a missing person...a man dressed in black?"
[ES] Veo que te mueves por ahí, matando grandes monstruos. Empezaba a pensar que solo estabas aquí para saquear las ruinas del campamento de la federación.

¿Así que esto es solo una visita de cortesía...?"Actually, I'm looking for a missing person...a man dressed in black?"

[EN] The...man in black?

I might have seen that fellow....but it's been a while. Is he a friend of yours?"Let's just say that we share an interest..."
[ES] ¿El... hombre de negro?

Puede que haya visto a ese tipo... pero ha pasado un tiempo. ¿Es amigo tuyo?"Let's just say that we share an interest..."

[EN] I see...

Well, if this "interest" of yours yields anything fruitful, we might just have something to talk about. And then my time might be worth money, after all."How much are we talking?"
[ES] Ya veo...

Bueno, si este "interés" tuyo produce algo fructífero, tal vez tengamos de qué hablar. Y entonces mi tiempo podría valer dinero después de todo."How much are we talking?"

[EN] Not more than I promised that treasure hunter, I assure you. Whoever delivers first takes the money.

This is all speculative, of course. If there's anything of value on this island, well, that would be news to me.

Do we understand one another?"I...believe we do. I'll be in touch."
[ES] No más de lo que le prometí a ese cazador de tesoros, te lo aseguro. Quien entregue primero se lleva el dinero.

Todo esto es especulativo, por supuesto. Si hay algo de valor en esta isla, bueno, eso sería una noticia para mí.

¿Nos entendemos?"I...believe we do. I'll be in touch."

[EN] And so we meet again. I hear you've been touring the disaster area. You must be very...curious.

Can I satisfy your curiosity?"I'm looking for a man in black. Apparently, he's gone missing."
[ES] Y así nos volvemos a encontrar. Me enteré de que has estado recorriendo la zona del desastre. Debes tener mucha... curiosidad.

¿Puedo satisfacer tu curiosidad?"I'm looking for a man in black. Apparently, he's gone missing."

[EN] That fellow?

He...I didn't realize he was missing...though I haven't seen him in some time now."Are you sure? He told me he was coming to talk to you."
[ES] ¿Ese tipo?

Él... no me di cuenta de que estaba desaparecido... aunque no lo he visto en un buen tiempo."Are you sure? He told me he was coming to talk to you."

[EN] Hm. Did he, now?

Well, it's interesting that he didn't mention you. We might be speaking of two different men in black.

In any event, I don't have any information for you."Well, if you can't help me, maybe I should talk to the Iron Order."
[ES] Mjum. ¿Eso dijo, eh?

Bueno, es interesante que no te haya mencionado. Puede que estemos hablando de dos hombres de negro diferentes.

De todos modos, no tengo ninguna información para ti."Well, if you can't help me, maybe I should talk to the Iron Order."

[EN] Those thugs? What would they know?

I wouldn't be surprised if they had something to do with all of this...the destruction of the World Tree, all those injuries and deaths...

But, please, by all means, if you must waste someone's time, I'd rather it was theirs and not mine."Okay. You've told me everything I need to know, anyway."
[ES] ¿Esos matones? ¿Qué van a saber ellos?

No me sorprendería que tuvieran algo que ver con todo esto... la destrucción del World Tree, todas esas lesiones y muertes...

Pero, por favor, hazlo, si debes hacerle perder el tiempo a alguien, prefiero que sea al de ellos y no al mío."Okay. You've told me everything I need to know, anyway."

[EN] I thought I told you to get lost."The man in black sent me."
[ES] Pensé que te había dicho que te largaras."The man in black sent me."

[EN] What for? He has my answer. Does he think I'll give you a different answer?"We thought you might have reconsidered."
[ES] ¿Para qué? Él ya tiene mi respuesta. ¿Piensa que te daré una respuesta diferente?"We thought you might have reconsidered."

[EN] What kind of game are you playing?

You listen to me: I held up my part of the bargain, and I still haven't seen any proof that he's held up his.

So unless you both want a good beating, you won't come back until you're ready to complete the deal."I'll...pass that along."
[ES] ¿Qué clase de juego estás jugando?

Escúchame bien: cumplí mi parte del trato, y todavía no he visto ninguna prueba de que él haya cumplido la suya.

Así que, a menos que ambos quieran una buena paliza, no regresarán hasta que estén listos para completar el trato."I'll...pass that along."

[EN] See that you do.

Because if you don't...if you and that treasure hunter don't deliver...you'll live just long enough to regret it.

Pass that along, too."You've made your point. I'm leaving."
[ES] Más te vale.

Porque si no... si tú y ese cazador de tesoros no cumplen... vivirán lo justo para arrepentirse.

Transmite eso también."You've made your point. I'm leaving."

[EN] Are you telling me all of the alliance magisters have had dealings with the treasure hunter?

The picture is still murky, but it's becoming clearer and clearer that this treasure hunter is the unifying thread...if not in fact the author of the destruction.

Okay, then, your next step should be finding him. I've got a better description of him, from Lam: black leather armor, with a dagger in his belt and twinswords on his back.

Lam says the treasure hunter's name is Zik."I've got it. I'll find him and get some answers."
[ES] ¿Me estás diciendo que todos los magisters de la alianza han tenido tratos con el cazador de tesoros?

El panorama sigue turbio, pero cada vez está más claro que este cazador de tesoros es el hilo conductor... si es que no es de hecho el autor de la destrucción.

Muy bien, entonces tu siguiente paso debería ser encontrarlo. Tengo una mejor descripción de él, dada por Lam: armadura de cuero negro, con una daga en el cinturón y dos espadas en la espalda.

Lam dice que el nombre del cazador de tesoros es Zik."I've got it. I'll find him and get some answers."
